page_title: AST 1-1 SHU | Aston Villa v Sheffield Utd 22/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' What was Matty Cash (Aston Villa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+8' That's a clear yellow card. Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) goes into the book.
90+7' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Douglas Luiz and easily beat the keeper with a header into the roof of the net from close range. 1:1.
90+7' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+7' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

90+3' Aston Villa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Cameron Archer who will be replaced by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd).
90' None of the Aston Villa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
89' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

87' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
87' No action against Jhon Duran (Aston Villa), and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Anthony Taylor got that spot on. VAR seen to good effect there!

87' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa), but referee Anthony Taylor must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
83' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
82' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
81' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) replaces Leon Bailey.
80' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

78' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Emiliano Martinez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Anis Ben Slimane as he is replaced by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
74' Here is a change. Lucas Digne is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Alex Moreno (Aston Villa).
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Moussa Diaby walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
74' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
74' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
73' Surely that's handball by one of the Sheffield Utd players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
72' The ball possession at the moment is 80:20.
69' The referee gives a yellow card to Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd).
67' The corner from John McGinn (Aston Villa) is hurriedly cleared.
66' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
65' Aston Villa have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
63' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Aston Villa due to a foul in the build-up play.
61' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
59' Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ollie Watkins finds Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
58' Andre Brooks goes off the pitch and Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
58' Chris Wilder decides to make a substitution. Yasser Larouci will be replaced by Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd).
57' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
55' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

54' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) and Matty Cash have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
51' The whistle blows and Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) is booked for an infringement.
51' Sheffield Utd are ruled offside.
49' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
49' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
48' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
48' Aston Villa hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Leon Bailey with a fine lofted pass.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
39' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
37' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
34' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Aston Villa.
33' A lofted cross from John McGinn (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
30' The ball rebounds to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
29' John McGinn (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
27' Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
26' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
22' John McGinn (Aston Villa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
19' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle as Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

18' Wesley Foderingham pulls off a great save to deny Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
17' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wesley Foderingham intercepts the ball.
15' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
13' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

12' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Aston Villa.
12' John McGinn (Aston Villa) works the corner short.
11' The Aston Villa players can’t believe it after referee Anthony Taylor signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
11' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
11' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Aston Villa for a penalty. Play continues.
9' A brilliant through ball from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) as he picks out Moussa Diaby, who darted into free space to take the pass.
7' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece.
4' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
3' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Aston Villa.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Sheffield Utd will kick the game off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
